source.title: How to Generate AI Videos Using Runway Gen 4.5

key_insights: Professional AI filmmakers prefer image-to-video over text-to-video
Runway 4.5 ranked 8th in Curious Refuge Labs testing
Temporal consistency and visual fidelity are key weaknesses
Kling outperforms Runway in most test scenarios
Google Veo 3.1 offers lip-sync capabilities Runway lacks
article_angle: Honest comparison of AI video generators with real-world testing results
target_audience: AI content creators, filmmakers, video editors
